title: Office of Undergraduate Research (Virginia Tech) (applications open)
description:
Virginia Tech's central Office of Undergraduate Research promotes, enhances, and expands undergraduate research opportunities across campus. It runs summer research programming, the First-Year Fralin Undergraduate Research Fellowship, and the Undergraduate Research Excellence Program (UREP), plus featured funding, an ambassadors program, and a Discovery LAUNCHpad for getting started.
